meta.name: apollo-deploy-integration
meta.description:
Deploy Apollo.io integrations to production.
Use when deploying Apollo integrations, configuring production environments,
or setting up deployment pipelines.
Trigger with phrases like "deploy apollo", "apollo production deploy",
"apollo deployment pipeline", "apollo to production".

copy.tagline: 部署 Apollo 集成到生产环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要把 Apollo 集成部署到生产环境
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're preparing Apollo integrations for production deployment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把 Apollo.io 集成部署到生产环境：生成多平台部署配置、健康检查地址和蓝绿发布流程，并在部署前做验证。它还会读取实施指南来逐步操作。
howto.when: 当你说出“deploy apollo”等触发词，或要求部署 Apollo 集成、配置生产环境、设置部署流水线时触发。

say.text: 帮我部署 Apollo 集成到生产环境。
say.note: 会开始生成部署配置和健康检查。

say.text: 为我的 Apollo 集成配置生产环境。
say.note: 会生成环境配置并检查先决条件。

say.text: 设置 Apollo 的部署流水线。
say.note: 会创建蓝绿发布和预检流程。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps deploy Apollo.io integrations to production: it generates multi-platform deployment configs, health check endpoints, and blue-green deployment workflows, and performs pre-deployment validation. It also reads the implementation guide and follows it step by step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "deploy apollo", or when you ask to deploy Apollo integrations, configure production environments, or set up deployment pipelines.

say_en.text: Deploy my Apollo integration to production.
say_en.note: Starts generating deployment configs and health checks.

say_en.text: Configure the production environment for my Apollo integration.
say_en.note: Generates environment config and checks prerequisites.

say_en.text: Set up the deployment pipeline for Apollo.
say_en.note: Creates a blue-green deployment and pre-deployment validation.
